title.zh: 合作社（NTUC Income 保险合作社有限公司——第 88 条豁免）命令 2023
title.en: Co-operative Societies (NTUC Income Insurance Co-operative Limited — Exemption from Section 88) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Co‑operative Societies (NTUC Income Insurance Co‑operative Limited — Exemption from Section 88) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 20 March 2023.
2. The society NTUC Income Insurance Co‑operative Limited is exempt from section 88 of the Act.
